data.name: Revolution's Eternal Debt
data.detailed_description:
Описание игры

Revolution's Eternal Debt» is a narrative-driven RPG that immerses you in an alternate history of the October Revolution, woven with threads of mysticism and demonic conspiracy. The year is 1917. Petrograd is not merely a powder keg of political passions. It is a sacrificial altar, upon which something capable of overturning the very fabric of existence is being prepared.

You are Gleb, an ordinary man who arrives in the capital searching for his missing sister. But instead of traces of her disappearance, you find traces of something else. Behind the facade of a fratricidal war lies another, more ancient conflict. Bolsheviks, monarchists, anarchists-they are all pawns in a game played by forces for whom human lives are mere currency. And at the helm of a terrifying new version of the "vanguard of the new world" stands a charismatic and fearsome leader, whose true motives are shrouded in darkness.

GAME FEATURES:

  • A Revolution of Words: Command the mood of the masses. During pivotal clashes, you can influence the outcome by addressing the crowd. Choose the right slogans, ignite fury, or sow doubt. Your rhetoric is a weapon that can lead your followers to victory or cast them beneath the treads of history. Your choices determine whose banner will fly over Smolny.

  • Deep Dialogue & Character Progression: Develop Gleb's unique facets of personality. Your skills will influence dialogue options, uncover secrets, and define who you become in this chaos-a prophet, a conspiracy theorist, a hero, or an opportunist.

  • Petrograd as a Living Organism: Explore gloomy back alleys, opulent mansions brimming with secrets, underground gambling dens, and occult laboratories. Every district lives its own life and guards its own mysteries.

  • Underground Card Clubs: Take a break from the street-level chaos. Earn trust, information, and resources by playing games of chance in secret clubs. Your luck is a resource as crucial as bullets.

  • Historical Figures Through a Distorted Lens: Encounter famous personas, but as a different reality might have shaped them. The Moloch of revolution demands sacrifices, and some have already paid their price, gaining inhuman power in return.

  • Dynamic Conflicts: Face tense turn-based combat encounters and stealth missions where you must hide from Cheka patrols-operatives who can perceive more than the average person.

  • Investigation and Choice: Search for your sister within a web of political intrigue and occult plots. Your decisions will determine not only her fate but also the fate of the city, the country, and perhaps the entire world. Who is the true enemy? The Tsar? Lenin? Or something that has awaited its hour for centuries?

Uncover the truth. Save your soul. Rewrite history.

«Revolution's Eternal Debt» is a story about the price of freedom and the nature of evil, where the next speech you give may be your last... or the first prayer to a new, dreadful deity.

data.short_description: Revolution is not an easy task. It takes a lot of blood sweat and tears. What price are you willing to pay to stop it? Find your missing sister in the chaos of the uprising. Unravel the occult conspiracies. Lead the masses from the shadows. Every choice you make changes the course of history.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 8.1
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible video card with min 512MB memory
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 11 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD 1800 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 11 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain mature content including depictions of violence (with blood), strong language, and references to alcohol/tobacco. The game also includes historical and political themes. There is no pornographic content and no depiction of sexual acts.
